summary: Full e2e verification of the legally enforceable payment framework on all four brands (/agreement/:tok, /balgores, /exp, /davidastburys). Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_payment_framework.py) covering: (1) terms.py — TERMS_VERSION='1.1', TERMS_DATE='13 September 2026', TERMS_LABEL='Version 1.1, dated 13 September 2026', exactly 15 clauses numbered 01..15, PAYMENT_SECTION.title='The fee, when you pay, and cancellation' with 4 paragraphs containing 'Nothing is payable today', 'six months', 'Reservation Agreement', 'VAT' and '14 day(s)', terms_plain_text() containing the version label, terms_sha256() a 64-hex string; (2) _plus_six_months('2026-09-13...')→'2027-03-13' and 2026-08-31 correctly clamps to 2027-02-28; (3) pdf_terms.build_agreement_pdf produces >4KB %PDF bytes; (4) GET /api/agreements/{tok} on all four brands exposes fee_due_at, terms_version, terms_sha256, payment_acknowledged (False pre-accept) and terms_pdf_available (False pre-accept); (5) POST /accept with {risk_ack:true} only → 422 with 'payment/fee/payable' in message; POST /accept with {payment_ack:true} only → 422 with 'risk' message; POST /accept with both → 200; (6) After accept, public_context contains payment_acknowledged=true, terms_version='Version 1.1, dated 13 September 2026', terms_sha256 (64 hex chars), terms_pdf_available=true, and fee_due_at exactly 6 calendar months after accepted_at; (7) GET /api/agreements/{tok}/terms.pdf returns application/pdf %PDF for an accepted agreement and 409 for pending; (8) email renderers _seller_confirmed_email, _agent_signed_email include the _payment_block text 'Nothing is payable today' and the exact fee_due_label ('13 March 2027' for a 2026-09-13 acceptance), _terms_pdf_attachment produces a base64 application/pdf attachment named Signed-Survey-Terms-{token}.pdf. Frontend (Playwright): payment box data-testid='agreement-payment-terms' renders exactly once on all four brand pages, sits inside data-testid='agreement-clauses' (so it prints), contains all four required paragraphs ('Nothing is payable today', 'six months', 'Reservation Agreement', 'VAT/invoicing', '14 day cancellation'), and the clause count is exactly 15 (01..15) on every brand. Intro shows 'Version 1.1, dated 13th September 2026' and the by-accepting note shows '(Version 1.1, dated 13 September 2026)' on all four brands. Confirmation modal on pending balgores & DA agreements: both required checkboxes render — agreement-details-ok-checkbox and the new agreement-payment-ok-checkbox with the positive framing 'I pay nothing today. I understand the survey fee is payable on completion of my sale, or by 13 March 2027, whichever comes first.' — agreement-confirm-accept is disabled with only one ticked, enabled once both ticked, and POST /accept returns 200. Post-accept both brands show data-testid='agreement-fee-countdown' with 'Payable by 13 March 2027' (agreement-fee-due-date), a working '181 days remaining' pill (agreement-fee-countdown-pill), the signed-copy version + SHA-256 line, and a working Download signed terms (PDF) link (agreement-terms-pdf-link) that resolves to /api/agreements/{tok}/terms.pdf and returns application/pdf %PDF (18KB). Timeline (agreement-timeline) on accepted agreements shows a final step 'Survey fee payable, or on completion' with '13 Mar 2027'. Regression: decline+reopen still works (200/200), risk acknowledgement still enforced (422 without risk_ack even if payment_ack is present), and the accept enforcement wording is correct (risk message before payment message when both missing).
critical_code_review_comments: Four separate agreement page components (pages/agreement.jsx, pages/balgores/agreement-balgores.jsx, pages/exp/agreement-exp.jsx, pages/da/agreement-da.jsx) now hold the same payment-terms markup, modal wiring, countdown card and timeline additions. Any future clause/date/label change will need editing in four places. Consolidating into a shared component with brand theme tokens would materially reduce risk before further clauses are added.

GET /agreements/{token}/terms.pdf regenerates the PDF from CLAUSES + PAYMENT_SECTION at request time rather than serving the exact bytes that were emailed. If terms.py is ever edited after acceptance, the endpoint returns 409 ('signed against an earlier version'), which is safe, but consider persisting the sealed PDF bytes at acceptance so the historical PDF stays reproducible even if the terms module is later revised.

Pre-existing (unrelated) test failures still present: tests/test_slack_email_status.py, tests/test_email_and_interest.py (SENDER_EMAIL asserts), test_agreements.py::test_valid_token_returns_public_context (needs SAMPLE_AGREEMENT_TOKEN), test_balgores_seller_direct.py::test_accept_seller_direct_agreement (stale, predates risk_ack/payment_ack), test_new_features.py / test_pricing_snapshot_and_package.py / test_sale_room_link.py (post /accept without the new acks). These are pre-existing and were called out in the main-agent context.
